requirements.title: Complex SQRT returns the principal value
requirements.definition: For complex X, SQRT returns the principal value with nonnegative real part, and a zero real part has imaginary-part sign matching the imaginary part of X.

pending.SQRT-complex-principal-real-nonnegative: Initialize a real sentinel to -9.0, evaluate REAL(SQRT(CMPLX(-3.0,4.0))), assert the observed value is greater than or equal to 0.0, and mutate the bound check to require a negative value.
pending.SQRT-complex-zero-real-imaginary-sign: Use IEEE_ARITHMETIC signed-zero support probes as admission guards, create complex inputs with negative real part and positive and negative zero imaginary parts, and assert IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE(AIMAG(SQRT(x))) follows the input imaginary sign; no claim is made on processors lacking signed-zero IEEE support.
